🛒 CALGARY GROCERY DEALS: Week Ending October 1, 2026 🛒
Apples, cheap bacon everywhere, and a few seafood steals. Here's your store-by-store game plan 👇

📍 SAFEWAY
Overall: 238 deals, top average score this week (57). Strongest all-around flyer.

🥩 RAW PROTEINS:
• $5.99 Compliments Raw Shrimp - 27% below avg $8.25, lowest price we've tracked
• $4.99 Bacon - 41% below avg $8.45
• $3.99 Fresh Atlantic Salmon Fillets - 63% below avg $10.81
• $6.00 Compliments Ground Pork - lowest price tracked, best across stores
🥬 PRODUCE:
• $1.99 Grape Tomatoes - 58% below avg, lowest price tracked
• $1.99 Honeycrisp Apples - 49% below avg, lowest price tracked
• $1.77 Apples - 62% below avg $4.65
🧀 DAIRY: $3.99 Cheese - 48% below avg | $3.49 Creamers - 41% below avg
❄️ FROZEN: $1.29 Frozen Entrées - 72% below avg $4.60
🍫 SNACKS: $2.29 Bars - 66% below avg, lowest price tracked
⚠️ Skip: The $6.99 ground beef is "best across stores," but it's 4% ABOVE its usual price.
💡 VERDICT: Make this your main stop for shrimp, bacon, apples and tomatoes.

📍 REAL CANADIAN SUPERSTORE
Overall: 287 deals, avg score 55. Huge volume and solid pantry prices.

🥩 RAW PROTEINS:
• $4.00 Chicken Thighs - 55% below avg $8.85, best across stores
• $5.88 Pork Stir Fry - lowest price tracked
• $9.00 Beef Stew - 20% below avg $11.30
🥬 PRODUCE:
• $1.92 Tomatoes on the Vine - 44% below avg, best across stores
• $1.99 Broccoli Crowns - 24% below avg, lowest price tracked
❄️ FROZEN: $3.99 PC Frozen Fruit - 17% below avg | $2.97 Eggo - lowest price tracked
🍫 SNACKS: $2.50 Nature Valley Sweet & Salty - 50% below avg
💡 VERDICT: Go for the chicken thighs. They're the best poultry deal in the city this week.

📍 CO-OP
Overall: 90 deals, avg score 48. Few deals, but the proteins are excellent.

🥩 RAW PROTEINS:
• $6.89 Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast - 31% below avg $10.04, best across stores

🍞 BAKERY: $1.99 Founders & Farmers Bread - lowest price tracked
💡 VERDICT: Worth a trip for chicken breast and fish.

📍 WALMART

🥩 RAW PROTEINS:
• $4.97 Great Value Bacon - 30% below avg $7.10, lowest price tracked
• $4.98 Searay Basa Fillets - lowest price tracked, best across stores
❄️ FROZEN: $2.97 Cavendish Onion Rings - 57% below avg | $3.47 Green Giant Veg - 31% below avg
🍫 SNACKS: $2.28 Bear Paws - 41% below avg | $1.97 Cheez-It - 36% below avg
🥫 PANTRY: $2.47 Campbell's Chunky - 38% below avg

📍 NO FRILLS

📍 SOBEYS
Overall: 240 deals, avg score 49. It mostly copies Safeway's flyer.
• Same prices on shrimp ($5.99), bacon ($4.99), grape tomatoes and Honeycrisp ($1.99), and frozen entrées ($1.29)
• $1.77 McIntosh Apples - 67% below avg, lowest price tracked
💡 VERDICT: Shop here only if it's closer than Safeway.

📝 BOTTOM LINE:
Safeway (or Sobeys) is your #1 stop for shrimp, bacon and produce. Hit Superstore for $4 chicken thighs, and Co-op for chicken breast and fish. Save-On is the rib stop. Walmart covers snacks and freezer fill-ups. Bacon is cheap nearly everywhere at about $5, so buy it wherever you already are.
